text:
alice: starting staged v2 rollout for /api/generate now (10% traffic). deploybot initiated. release notes: https://go/relnotes/v2. please watch client errors and tenant impact.

deploybot: rollout event: v2 -> staged 10% (shard 42). next step in 5m if no regressions. started by alice.

carol-sre: seeing a small uptick in 4xx from mobile clients around 23:50 UTC, mostly eu-west. baseline to 0.6% -> 1.8% request errors. investigating.

ben-infra: logs show schema mismatch errors from v2 responses for some requests:
```json
{"error":"schema_mismatch","expected":"choices[]","received":"result"}
```
Looks like clients expecting v1 shape are getting routed to v2.

dave-sdk: our mobile SDK 1.2 does NOT set X-API-Version header (relies on default routing to v1). Why are default/no-header clients hitting v2?

alice: that shouldn't happen. pausing rollout now.

deploybot: rollout paused at 10% by alice. current traffic fraction remains on v2=10%.

ben-infra: quick mitigation: patch gateway default route to prefer v1 when X-API-Version is absent. patch command: `kubectl patch cm gateway-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"default-version":"v1"}}'`

carol-sre: confirming tenant edu-apps in eu-west showing the spike. will tail proxy and mark when errors drop.

dave-sdk: we can ship SDK 1.2.1 in ~30m to start sending X-API-Version=v2 for opt-in. prefer gateway hotfix first to avoid user impact.

alice: plan: 1) apply gateway default->v1 hotfix (ben) 2) monitor for 10m (carol) 3) release SDK patch and coordinate a safe re-rollout later window. handoff to night ops @ 00:15 UTC. agree?

carol-sre: will run canary retry script and post pass/fail.

dave-sdk: +1, will queue SDK patch and post CI link once ready.

alice: thanks all. I'll update release notes and notify support to hold any tenant escalations. :thumbsup:

carol-sre: post-mitigation check: error rate dropped back to baseline after gateway patch, marking incident mitigated for now.

alice: closing thread for now. will reopen on roll resume.
